text:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Embedder throughput spike detected on embed-prod (latency >500ms p95). Automatic pager sent to @alex. Affected: ~4% of requests. Runbook: <https://runbooks/internal/embedder-throughput|embedder throughput>.

alex: Oncall alex here. jumping in — starting with traces + qps breakdown.

devon: pulling traces now, enabling debug logs for embedder workers. will try to reproduce tail traffic.

maria: I see a KV eviction storm in the metrics (kvcache.evictions spiked). correlating with a model rollout window ~3175312000.

alex: good catch @maria. devon, can you confirm timeline vs rollout? if so we may have cache miss amplification.

devon: timeline matches. rollout finished ~5m before spike. logs show repeated cold starts + large batch sizes.

incident-bot: Mitigation action: scaled embedder pool by +2 nodes (auto-scale override) at 3175312780. Error-rate and latency trending down.

alex: mitigated for now. still want a proper postmortem and action items. I propose a kickoff sync Thu 10:00 (30m) to triage RCA and size remediations. @emily can you set the calendar?

emily: I can. booked "Embedder sev2 postmortem sync" Thu 10:00-10:30, invite: alex, devon, maria, paul, infra-sre. calendar: https://calendar/internal/evt/3175313000

paul: From a prioritization standpoint: severity and customer impact look limited (~4% of requests degraded), but risk of recurrence during next rollout is non-trivial. Recommend action items be triaged into: (A) Immediate fixes (1-3d), (B) Short-term preventions (1-2 wks), (C) Long-term reliability work (quarter tie-in).

maria: Drafting action items now. rough sizing estimates: 
- ACTION-1: KV cache eviction tuning + guardrail (owner: maria) — 2d (1 SWE)
- ACTION-2: Add rollout canary threshold tied to kvcache hit-rate (owner: devon) — 3d (1 SWE + 0.5 SRE)
- ACTION-3: Autoscaler safety: cap burst scaling to avoid amplification (owner: infra-sre) — 4d (1 SRE)
- ACTION-4: Postmortem doc & RCA (owner: emily) — 1d (writing)
- ACTION-5: Add regression test in staging: simulated cold-cache rollout (owner: paul) — 5d (1 SWE + test infra)

alex: solid. For backlog prioritization, I'd mark ACTION-1 and ACTION-2 as P1 for the next sprint; ACTION-3 as P2 but start design this quarter; ACTION-5 should be Q2 perf-sprint candidate.

paul: Agree. I'll link ACTION-1/2 to the next sprint board and create JIRA tickets. Suggested titles: "kvcache: guardrail to prevent eviction storms" and "rollout: require kvcache hit-rate canary".

emily: I'll own the postmortem doc. Proposed template outline in the doc: Impact, Timeline, RCA, Mitigation timeline, Action items with owners + estimates, Preventative tests. I'll post a draft within 24h.

maria: quick config note for the team: current kvcache eviction policy is `lru_threshold=0.75` with immediate background eviction; propose `lru_threshold=0.9` + soft-throttle during rollouts. Example snippet to test:

```yaml
kvcache:
  eviction_threshold: 0.9
  background_eviction: delayed
  rollout_soft_throttle: true
```

devon: thanks. I'll run a canary in staging with that config and simulate a rollout to verify.

alex: follow-ups: 
- emily: postmortem doc (due +24h)
- maria: ACTION-1 config change PR and test (estimate 2d)
- devon: ACTION-2 canary impl + staging test (3d)
- paul: create JIRA tickets and tag Q2 perf-sprint for ACTION-5
- infra-sre: assess autoscaler changes (ACTION-3) and give sizing estimate by EOW

incident-bot: Postmortem kickoff scheduled Thu 10:00. Postmortem doc created at https://docs/internal/embedder-sev2-pm/3175312468 (emily).

sre-bot: Note: tagging incident severity -> sev2; please file runbook updates if config changes land.

alex: Thanks team. I'll follow up in the doc with timeline snapshots and a short customer-impact blurb for the product team. :thumbsup:

maria: one more note — recommend adding a regression eval in Redwood Optimize to catch perf regressions during model rollouts. that would be ACTION-6 (owner: research) — 2w. Adding to doc.

paul: OK, closing the live page. We'll track remediation tickets and re-evaluate priority after the postmortem.

alex: Closing thread for live mitigation. Leave comments on the postmortem doc for any missing items.
